modules.reason: Single/Multiple collect specific reference molecular structures to a capacity. Playground has zero collection boxes and remains free molecule construction.

screens.label: 单个分子
screens.correctness: CollectionBox.willAllowMoleculeDrop(candidate): moleculeType.isEquivalent(candidate) && quantityProperty.value < capacity. isFull(): quantityProperty.value === capacity. KitCollection updates allCollectionBoxesFilledProperty from every box.isFull().
screens.stableIdentity: cid + capacity + screen is the stable goal signature; collection.id/currentIndex/box index distinguish session instances. moleculeId is a creation counter and is unsuitable as a stable ID.
screens.minimumReader: Read existing currentCollection and reference atoms/bonds; give current per-element counts, numbered bond adjacency/order, target capacity, collected and remaining quantities. Subscribe or poll without changing model/RNG. Formula alone cannot prove structural equivalence.

validation.runtimeProbe: all 18 screens navigated and existing public model values inspected after guide readiness; no model setter/RNG calls; no collection generated/solved during this audit
validation.runtimeNavigation: Old BAM Joist uses actual sim.screenProperty and sim.homeScreen; selectedScreenProperty preserves the home-screen selection. The reader prioritizes actual screenProperty and returns null when actual screen is outside sim.simScreens.

limits: Audit classifies native goals; it does not claim instructional implementation or solve every state.
Generated BAM collections have many combinations and repeated instances; finite enumeration here is of reference target molecules/capacities, not all collections/atom positions.

moleculeCollectionPool.generationEvidence: BAMModel.generateKitCollection: choose unique members of collectionBoxMolecules; single capacity=1; multiple random integer 1..3 capped at 2 when C atom count>1. Initial Multiple H2 capacity=4 is separate. Original generator was only read, never invoked.
moleculeCollectionPool.nativeStructureJudgment: MoleculeStructure.isEquivalent compares element histogram and neighbor topology; checkEquivalency does not inspect bond.order. The simplified 2D tool edits adjacency, not double/triple bond order. Reference bond orders are explanatory advanced information only.

followupImplementation.scopeNote: Original audit gap retained as history; both collection readers are now implemented. Native empty black slots at quantity zero are expected.
